facts.fact: RFI describes the Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information (Anssi) as the authority responsible for securing Côte d'Ivoire's national digital space, which led the Cyber.Ex national drill in Abidjan on 28-29 October 2026.

systems.country_label: Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information (Anssi)

note: The count of 147 major vulnerabilities since January is neither an incident handled, an alert issued nor a published count of incidents or alerts; the drill is an exercise.
